1_seven_agents_exist_with_claimed_ids_ha.method: Independently computed SHA-256 of all 7 live .claude/agents/<name>.md files via sha256sum, compared byte-for-byte against public.agents.definition_hash queried live via npx supabase db query --linked. Exact match on all 7. All 7 claimed UUIDs, names, categories, definition_path, active=true confirmed via direct SELECT. execution_provider/has_production_authority confirmed true only for the 5 agents whose frontmatter has permissionMode: auto (factory-director, implementation-engineer, db-security-engineer, integration-engineer, verifier); false/null for product-architect and release-operator, consistent with their frontmatter lacking that line and with sync-agents.mjs's own hasProductionAuthority = fm.permissionMode === 'auto' logic and PHASE_6_FINDINGS.md's documented design. NOTE: the launch prompt's blanket claim that all 7 have has_production_authority=true was false for 2 of 7 - correct system behavior, but a real narrative/reality mismatch caught by independent re-derivation rather than trusting the prompt.

2_exactly_one_row_per_name.method: SELECT name, count(*) FROM public.agents WHERE name LIKE 'brain-os-%' GROUP BY name - all 7 return count=1. Total agents = 16 = 9 pre-existing legacy (category IS NULL, untouched) + 7 new, matching migration's own claim.

3_insert_scope_policy_and_view_security_.method: Direct pg_policy query (not trusting migration file text): agent_runs_insert_scope with_check_expr is exactly is_founder_or_admin(). agents_with_live_status confirmed via pg_class.reloptions to have security_invoker=true. RLS confirmed enabled (relrowsecurity=true) on both agents and agent_runs. agents table policies confirmed unchanged: agents_select_authenticated (auth.uid() is not null) + agents_write_admin (is_founder_or_admin(), ALL commands).

4_adversarial_non_admin_insert_and_updat.method: Inside a rolled-back transaction, impersonated a real ordinary employee identity (auth sub 9c92a8d5-853c-4ef3-846a-f4fe8c42d97a / profile 66ef2052-..., the same real test identity already proven live in the canonical_work_order_model_adversarial pass) via set local role authenticated + request.jwt.claims. Attempted UPDATE has_production_authority/execution_provider on brain-os-product-architect - silently rejected by RLS, row unchanged (still null/false), confirmed by direct re-SELECT. Attempted INSERT of a fabricated agent_runs row (company_id null, real target agent_id for brain-os-db-security-engineer, fake summary/verification_status='e2e_verified') - 0 rows persisted, confirmed by direct re-SELECT for that summary marker post-attempt.

5_real_dispatch_chain.method: claude agents --json showed session c5d1ffd3 as a real background-kind process, state done, cwd=C:\Users\Dell\dev\brain-os. claude logs c5d1ffd3, ANSI-stripped and grepped (not summarized/trusted from a report) shows real persona @brain-os-implementation-engineer, real prompt text matching phase6-registry-dispatch-test.mjs's literal task string, and real response '● REGISTRY DISPATCH OK'. A real SQL JOIN (not two isolated existence checks) of agent_runs to agents confirmed row f5aafcf7-3dd1-4693-9aff-ba02cde80a9f has agent_id=7703cae0-2a4f-4f11-b79f-f1bff1904820 (name brain-os-implementation-engineer) and provider_run_id=c5d1ffd3. Read provider.mjs's startRunByAgentId source directly - confirmed it genuinely re-queries public.agents by id (no hardcoded name/path), refuses on inactive/no-execution_provider/no-production-authority/no-definition_path, and re-computes the live file's real SHA-256 against the stored definition_hash before every dispatch, refusing on mismatch.

6_regression_script_passes_live_rollback.method: Ran qa/scenarios-runner/factory_agent_registry_adversarial.sql wrapped in BEGIN;...ROLLBACK; against real production (migration DDL already live, matching the file's own stated assumption). All 8 named assertions returned all_pass: true: FACTORY_AGENT_SYNC_NO_DUPLICATE_SLUG, FACTORY_AGENT_DEFINITION_HASH_DETECTS_CHANGE, FACTORY_UNKNOWN_AGENT_CANNOT_EXECUTE, FACTORY_AGENT_CANNOT_SELF_ESCALATE_AUTHORITY, FACTORY_STATUS_DERIVED_FROM_REAL_RUN (across IDLE/RUNNING/FAILED states), FACTORY_AGENT_RUN_REFERENCES_CANONICAL_AGENT, FACTORY_STATUS_CANNOT_BE_SPOOFED_VIA_FAKE_AGENT_RUN. hash_before in the test output (7c5d1d41...) matched my own independently-computed SHA-256 for brain-os-implementation-engineer exactly, confirming the test ran against real live data, not a fixture copy. Post-ROLLBACK re-query confirmed zero residue: definition_hash reverted to the real value, 0 duplicate-slug rows, 0 spoofed-marker rows, 0 fake-FK-test rows.

7_persist_verification_result.method: UPDATE public.agent_runs SET verification_status='e2e_verified' WHERE id='f5aafcf7-3dd1-4693-9aff-ba02cde80a9f', run live via npx supabase db query --linked. Re-confirmed via a separate, fresh, independent SELECT (not the UPDATE's own RETURNING): verification_status='e2e_verified', agent_id and provider_run_id unchanged and correct. total rows with verification_status='e2e_verified' across the whole table = 2 (this row + the pre-existing Phase 5 bootstrap row 8edcdf3e set in the prior campaign) - no unintended rows touched.
